name: axis-bank-automation
description: Axis Bank Portal Automation using Playwright

scripts.test: npm run validate:prod && npm run env:prod && playwright test
scripts.start:axis: npm run validate:prod && npm run env:prod && node scripts/runAxisVerificationWorker.js
scripts.test:axis: npm run validate:prod && npm run env:prod && playwright test tests/axis/axisFlow.spec.js --headed
scripts.debug:axis: npm run validate:prod && npm run env:prod && playwright test tests/axis/axisFlow.spec.js --headed --debug
scripts.debug:worker:axis: npm run validate:prod && npm run env:prod && node --inspect-brk scripts/runAxisVerificationWorker.js
scripts.debug:axis:inspector: npm run validate:prod && npm run env:prod && set PWDEBUG=1&& node scripts/runAxisVerificationWorker.js
scripts.update-status: npm run env:prod && playwright test tests/updateStatus.spec.js
